summary: Completed both backend and frontend testing for Manufacturer Dashboard Drill-Down (Inventory + Distributors). All 13 new backend pytest cases pass (enriched catalog, product detail, distributor detail, PATCH product, PATCH distributor, POST /inventory/adjust delta+set+errors, distributor /inventory regression). Frontend smoke flow verified end-to-end: login as Unilever -> /inventory shows manufacturer-inventory-view with 15 rows -> click row opens product-drawer -> View full details navigates to /products/{id} rendering manufacturer-product-detail -> Edit product and Adjust inventory dialogs both open -> Back returns to /inventory -> /network has 91 distributor rows -> click opens distributor-drawer -> View full details navigates to /distributors/{id} rendering manufacturer-distributor-detail. Distributor role on /inventory correctly shows the legacy distributor inventory list (no manufacturer-inventory-view).

critical_code_review_comments: Manufacturer routes are well-factored — uses _id projection consistently and gracefully degrades when no shipments/sales exist.
update_product / update_distributor correctly whitelist allowed fields and ignore unknown keys — verified by test_patch_valid_and_unknown.
adjust_inventory creates the row on first touch (good ergonomics), supports both delta and absolute modes, and writes an inventory_audit record with prev/new/delta plus reason — solid auditability.

manufacturer_product_detail computes inventory_turnover as units / max(stock,1) * (365/90) — protected against div-by-zero but on a zero-stock product turnover becomes huge. Consider returning null when stock is 0.
manufacturer_distributor_detail correctly returns growth_rate_pct=null when prev_units==0 (no false 100% growth signal).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on functional flows (drawer open, drill-down nav, dialog open, back nav, role-split)

seed_data_creation: No new seed. Backend tests adjust inventory then restore the original quantity in the same test; PATCH product/distributor revert to original price/phone. Inventory_audit collection accumulates 3 rows per test_delta_and_set_modes run (audit only — does not affect business data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_manufacturer_drilldown.py — they self-clean (PATCH revert + inventory_adjust restore). Frontend drawer + drill-down + dialog opens all verified via Playwright. The Contact mailto link is conditional on distributor.contact_email; the first distributor (alphabetical) lacked an email in seed which is why a[href^='mailto:'] count was 0 in the smoke test, not a regression. To re-test mailto, pick a distributor whose contact_email is non-empty (verified in source: ManufacturerDistributorDetail.jsx renders `<a href='mailto:...' data-testid='contact-distributor-btn'>` when contact_email is set).
